name: SKA-Low
place: Murchison Radio-astronomy Observatory (Inyarrimanha Ilgari Bundara), Western Australia
description: The low-frequency half of the Square Kilometre Array, planned as 131,072 antennas covering 50 to 350 MHz, under construction on Wajarri Yamaji land at the CSIRO Murchison site.
highlights: Construction began on 5 December 2022 and the first antennas were placed in 2024.
In March 2025 it produced its first image using about 1,000 of the planned 131,000 antennas.
Science operations are projected for 2027 to 2032.
